card.title: A council of AI agents trades for you, inside a limit the chain enforces.
card.sub: For people who want an agent to trade crypto and perps for them, without handing it their money.

lines: The full walkthrough of XORR, for people who want an agent to trade without handing over their money: the whole journey on a local fork of Monad mainnet, then live on Monad testnet.

segments.label: Before sign-up
segments.sub: Three screens, then Monad's blocks going final
lines: Three screens before sign-up: five seats vote on every trade, only inside your limit, and Monad's blocks go final in about half a second, live.

segments.label: The account
lines: One passkey creates the account: no email, no seed phrase, and nothing that can sign is stored. Then a thousand test dollars land at your own address.

segments.label: The permission
lines: The permission is the heart of it: a daily limit, an end date and the venues, signed without a popup and confirmed on chain in under ten seconds.

segments.label: The stateless test
lines: Wipe the browser's storage and sign in with the passkey alone: the same account comes back.

segments.label: Home and markets
lines: Home shows your balance and agents. Markets shows live prices, and each buy is checked against Chainlink.

segments.label: A buy, routed
segments.sub: Kuru's order book vs Uniswap v3
lines: Buy twenty dollars of MON. XORR measures Kuru's on-chain order book against Uniswap v3 and fills on whichever delivers more: here Kuru, by about a third of a percent.

segments.label: The speed receipt
lines: Every fill carries a speed receipt: executed in five hundred and ten milliseconds, for a tenth of a cent of gas.

segments.label: The council
lines: Put fifty dollars of MON to the council. Price, Risk, Trend and Perps read Monad's own numbers, and Kimi weighs the four.
Approved five to nothing: vote to fill in two tenths of a second.

segments.label: The replay
lines: Any round can be replayed, seat by seat, with exactly what each desk read when it voted, then the verdict and what the chain did.

segments.label: The Perpl desk
lines: Perps run on Perpl, with AUSD margin, in a desk that is Perpl's own delegated account. XORR's key can place orders on it, but never withdraw.

segments.label: Long, exits, close
lines: Open a long on MON, priced from Perpl's book, with its distance to liquidation and exits checked every thirty seconds. Close it, and the margin is back in the desk.

segments.label: Perpl risk
lines: Perpl risk shows every market's funding, open interest and spread, and flags what deserves a look.

segments.label: History, by Envio
lines: History is the on-chain record: every grant, spend and desk, indexed by Envio's HyperIndex as the blocks arrive.

segments.label: The gauntlet
lines: The gauntlet: three hundred and thirteen strategies backtested, and ten survived tests on data they never saw.

segments.label: Built on Monad
segments.sub: Commit states · txpool · P256 · staking · x402
lines: Built on Monad reads the chain itself. Here, Monad's P256 precompile verifies the passkey's signature.

segments.label: One hold stops it
lines: Hold to stop: the permission is revoked and the desk's operator removed, on chain, and read back before the app says trading stopped.

segments.label: Live on Monad testnet
lines: Now the same product, live on Monad testnet, at xorr-metropolis dot vercel dot app, open in any browser.

segments.label: Built on Monad, live
lines: The hosted executor reads Monad mainnet's commit states live, and every item says where it runs.

segments.label: A testnet round
segments.chip: TEAM-SEEDED WALLET · LABELLED IN THE APP
lines: A round convened tonight from a wallet we seeded and labelled, open to anyone: approved four to nothing, with Kimi explaining its yes.

card.title: execOrder on Perpl, through the owner's desk

lines: Its fill: execOrder from XORR's operator key to the owner's Perpl desk, on Monad testnet.

card.kicker: THE STOP · TESTNET PROOF RUN, 13 OCT
card.title: removeOperator: xorr's key taken off the desk

lines: And the stop on testnet: the owner removing XORR's key from the desk.

card.title: The operator's side
stats: Node and Hono with Postgres, signs only inside the grant
HyperIndex over HyperSync, the History feed
MON price report to XorrPriceReceiver on testnet

lines: Under the hood, the executor signs only inside each owner's grant. Envio's HyperIndex feeds History, a Chainlink CRE workflow writes the MON price on chain, and other agents can buy the council's read over x402.
